research_question: Can a continuing lineage induce one executable reusable skill from external-model demonstrations, serialize it as a lineage-owned capsule, remove the model completely, and use only that capsule to repair fresh held-out programs that were never shown to the teacher?

generalized_capsule_may_count_as_bridge_: the teacher emits only solved training examples, never the generalized rewrite template
the lineage induces the generalized executable transformation from at least four distinct demonstrations
the capsule is serialized before holdout task content is materialized
the external model is unavailable during every holdout decision and transformation
the lineage chooses every held-out match binding and transformation argument itself
epistemic_bridge.claim_if_positive: bounded model-to-lineage skill appropriation mechanism evidence, not a retroactive Genesis Gate 2 completion claim

teacher.interface: complete Python source replacement for one training task
teacher_may_see: the instruction to preserve the signature and return a complete replacement

task_family.module_shape: one pure function plus harmless distractor assignments
task_family.latent_training_failure: a two-operand division return expression fails the zero-denominator evaluator case
task_family.teacher_instruction: Repair the function so division by zero returns numeric zero while non-zero division preserves Python true-division semantics. Preserve the function signature. Return only the complete Python module.

control_arms.complete_lineage: apply the induced capsule by structural matching and lineage-chosen bindings
control_arms.memorizer: may replay a teacher output only on an exact training-source SHA-256 match; unseen hashes remain unchanged
control_arms.corrupted_teacher: one teacher repair is deterministically corrupted before induction; induction must refuse to create a capsule
control_arms.teacher_call_trap: any attempt to invoke an external model after the removal boundary fails the experiment

failure_classification.negative: any preregistered positive threshold condition fails, including teacher failure, ambiguous induction, holdout failure, a control solving a holdout, or any model call after teacher removal
failure_classification.inconclusive: only repository or CI infrastructure prevents the deterministic experiment from executing before any scientific result is produced
failure_classification.positive: the entire conjunction in preregistered_positive_threshold holds without changing the protocol, task seeds, demonstrations, capsule, evaluator or controls after observation

prohibited_adaptation: change training or holdout seeds after any teacher output
show holdout materialized content to the teacher
hand-write the generalized capsule after seeing teacher outputs
filter or replace a teacher demonstration because induction rejects it
change the capsule after any holdout content is materialized
interpret a positive result as general software engineering, open-ended learning, AGI, consciousness or safe deployment
